headlines.text: Fed's rate decision due today at 2pm ET, widely expected to hold at 3.75%-4.00% as Powell faces questions on sticky inflation
Broadcom shares jumped ~4% Tuesday as Wall Street banks and Blackstone line up $63 billion in financing for its AI chips destined for Anthropic
Nasdaq closed up 1.14% to 26,467 Tuesday on the chip-stock rally, S&P 500 gained 0.57%, Dow roughly flat as Boeing's slide offset gains
UPS topped Q3 estimates with revenue up 6.7% to $22.9 billion and raised full-year EPS and free-cash-flow guidance
Boeing shares sank about 9% Tuesday after a wider-than-expected Q3 loss and a delay to its 737 MAX production ramp-up until late 2027
Brent crude slipped below $115 and WTI near $100 as Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan hold talks with Iran, easing Mideast supply fears
Alphabet and Microsoft report earnings after the bell today, with Amazon following Thursday, as Wall Street scrutinizes AI capex
